description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the 'Thumb' controller within the OpenCart project, specifically handling product thumbnail related functionalities. It extends the base Controller class and primarily includes a method to render the product thumbnail view with relevant data.

classes.name: Thumb
classes.description: Controller class for handling product thumbnail display in the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates the product thumbnail view, assembling necessary data such as cart URLs, wishlist URLs, and review status, then renders the 'product/thumb' view template.
